clips.title: The story
paras: Thorn Hill is a fortified Razormane quilboar enclave nestled on the high ridges east of the Crossroads in the Barrens. The settlement serves as a forward base for quilboar warbands raiding Horde supply lines traveling between Durotar and the interior savanna.

Perched on the north face of the rugged hills between Durotar and the Crossroads, Thorn Hill commands a watchful vantage over the primary trade corridors of the Barrens. The settlement is home to a dangerous gathering of the Razormane tribe, including hunters, trained wolves, and earth-shaping geomancers. Guided by mystics like Elder Mystic Razorsnout, the quilboar here have escalated their attacks against passing Horde supply caravans. Because this mountain camp sits so close to vital transit routes, the guards at the Crossroads consider Thorn Hill one of the most immediate military hazards in the central savanna.
